stable.label: native-fluid-projection-v3-ci-pass
stable.note: Native pressure-projection v3 remains the active browser stable slice. The new body-mechanics v1 kernel is a separately CI-passed native candidate and is not yet loaded by the active route. Browser execution and iPhone execution remain unverified.

active_experience.runtime: from-scratch C++ compiled to WebAssembly owns 3D material occupancy, signed water velocity, divergence and pressure-projection state; a JavaScript Worker verifies the exact compiler-proven WASM payload and transfers packed native state to a from-scratch WebGPU volume ray marcher
simulated_state: native kinetic energy and signed XYZ momentum
deterministic seeded state evolution including velocity/pressure
render_coupling: 3D solid/water density derives from native occupancy
surface normals derive from native field gradients
sand wetness derives from native moisture
water turbidity derives from native suspended sediment
native pressure is dynamics/telemetry and is not relabeled as visual sediment
water shape derives from simulated water occupancy rather than animated geometry
approximations: water remains a coarse binary occupancy quantum per voxel
pressure projection is a discrete voxel-scale incompressibility constraint
advection moves a water voxel at most one neighboring cell per substep rather than continuous characteristic tracing
viscosity is approximated by bounded damping
ray marching interpolates simulation state for presentation only
native body-mechanics v1 exists as a standalone CI-passed candidate but is not loaded by the active browser route

tests: fresh native C++ projection fixture passes
explicit impulse produces signed native momentum and kinetic energy
pressure projection does not increase measured divergence
reference fixture reduced divergence from 16457 to 12340
fixed-seed plus fixed-impulse replay includes velocity/pressure state
exact browser payload hash equals fresh compiler output
material invariant forbids motion/pressure on non-water cells

mechanics: yield threshold with plastic rest-length change
approximations: particle-and-distance-joint mechanics, not rigid-body angular inertia tensors
contact is currently a flat floor plane, not native voxel material geometry
friction uses a bounded velocity-drop approximation rather than a full complementarity contact solve
plasticity changes joint rest length after predicted strain exceeds yield; no fracture topology yet
not compiled into the active browser WASM payload and not rendered in the active experience

ci.first_failure: yield telemetry was sampled before external-load prediction
ci.fix: sample strain/yield after integration and before elastic constraint relaxation

tests: compliant joint error remains bounded under load
contact friction does not accelerate tangential motion and dissipates it
strain above yield changes rest length and increments yield telemetry
fixed setup and impulses replay to identical native hash

native_volume_renderer.truth: WebGPU ray marching is presentation over native 3D state; time-driven fake water-normal animation is forbidden; water normals derive from native water-density gradients and turbidity derives from native suspended sediment, never pressure.

active_objective: Integrate the CI-passed native body-mechanics kernel with the actual voxel material world: compile it into the active WASM module, collide body particles against native solid occupancy instead of a flat floor, and expose body state to rendering without scripted pose animation.
next_gate: The body/world coupling must pass deterministic tests for voxel non-penetration, momentum response to material contact, friction bounds on sloped/irregular voxel surfaces, water-force coupling derived from native fluid velocity/pressure state, conservation/error telemetry, exact WASM rebuild proof, and fixed-seed replay before the active route may claim native articulated organisms.
next_scientific_blocker: Body-to-material coupling: the mechanics candidate has real mass/joints/contact/yield, but its contact geometry is still a flat plane and it is not yet coupled to native voxel solids, native water momentum/pressure, active WASM, or the WebGPU body representation.
invariants: exact browser WASM must match fresh compiler SHA-256
WebGPU simulation-looking motion must derive from native state
pressure must never masquerade as sediment/turbidity
do not call this validated CFD
Stable vs Lab isolation remains fail-closed
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
